title: Ancestries in random $d$-DAGs
summary: We consider a random recursive DAG $G_n$ on the vertex set $[n]$ where every vertex $i\geq 2$ has out-degree $d$, with the targets chosen uniformly at random among the earlier $i-1$ vertices. For this model, we propose a novel way to investigate the descendants of $n$ (which have recently been studied in a paper by Janson) through what we call ancestry processes. The ancestor process $a_i(n)$ of a vertex $i$ is defined as the number of ancestors of $i$ in $G_n$, and is closely related to the evolutions of multi-draw Pólya urns.
